lines:
Execution order: Markdown step 1 of 12. Start from the existing completed SQLite/text storage foundation. Follow the Markdown tasks in order; finish and verify each prerequisite before beginning the next. This sequence does not require the still-planned server SQL backend.

Implement the approved first-class Markdown artefact contract in src-tauri/storage-api and the shared ProjectStore boundary. This phase defines production API/data semantics; it is not a second documentation file.
Scope:
- Add MarkdownDesignDocument with stable externalId, title, complete body and ordered typed designLinks. Empty links are project scope; links are associations, not containment. Keep this DTO distinct from the existing generic DesignDocument snapshot/token envelope.
- Introduce target kind markdown and upsert_markdown/delete_markdown mutations. Cover inventory, metadata summaries, explicit complete reads, scope/by-id/binding lookup, body/title search, typed associations/backlinks, direct file/symbol bindings, validation, resource keys and canonical snapshot tokens.
- Reuse atomic Mutation/CommitResult, operation receipts, fresh-token conflict handling and no-op behavior. Tokens cover editable canonical data; generated paths/headers and unrelated project changes do not alter tokens.
- Define deletion as reject-while-referenced unless all affected references are explicitly removed/relinked in the same guarded transaction; deleting architecture must not cascade-delete prose.
- Extend the real driver-neutral trait, DTO serialization/schema exports, shared validators, facade dispatch and conformance fixtures. Do not leak SQLite types or add successful default methods that silently omit Markdown. Stage compilation changes explicitly; do not advertise backend support before adapter implementation.
Acceptance:
- Contract tests cover serialization, identity/project/reference validation, token stability and required guard semantics for Markdown while existing domains still compile and pass their contract tests.
- Subsequent adapters have one unambiguous shared contract, and get/list semantics distinguish bounded metadata from complete editable content.

Formal design: retrieve the linked owner specifications and MarkdownDesignArtifactModel. All Markdown requirements saved on 2026-09-25 are approved design with implementation pending.

data.title: Markdown 01/12 — Extend the shared design document and storage API contract
